featured_reviews.name: Meet Sanghvi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Binoy Mehta @ Binoy Mehta Advisory (Edu World) Vile Parle West

Overview – Too Long Didn’t Read -
Binoy M. personally worked with me throughout the process right from designing the SOP’s (took me 6 attempts) to deciding & accepting the final offer. Preparing for the visa interview, documentation, mockup to finally getting the visa in hand. He guided me throughout the process and solved all my questions and queries.

The Process – In-depth
1.	University Shortlisting - Started with university shortlisting as my GRE & TOEFL tests were over and I had the results in hand. Explained how to look for a university and how to evaluate them
2.	Applications – He showed and guided me through the application portal for the first university and helped write up the contents for the various questions asked. Then almost all universities had similar applications, and he was always there if there was any query
3.	Responses Waiting & Follow up Phase – After the initial applications, he also guided me on how to make application for internal switch for certain admits that I had received.
4.	Choosing a university – after weighing the pros and cons of each university, understanding the demographic, choice of subjects, field, Job prospects, connecting with his former students in particular universities, we finally chose the university (I study at Arizona State University)
5.	The VISA process – It was a very difficult process as the seats would open at any random time in the day. But Binoy, was personally following up and tracking the slots for visa booking on the website and his other colleagues to make sure all of us received the slots in time for the upcoming semester. I was one of his first few students to get the slot very early.
6.	The Interview Prep (mocks) – this process had actually started long back even before the I had started applications because I was tensed about the visa as I had relatives living in the US and it made a dicey case on my end. He guided me throughout, formulated and devised a plan and got me through the process UNTIL I finally got the VISA. I was so nervous he once told me “You don’t need to be so nervous. On the day of the visa when you get it, you’ll feel – all this effort was for nothing (as in the interview will be so very easy) you are worrying about nothing. Stop over thinking.” And infact my interview was smooth as butter, I was only asked 4 questions, and nothing about my case in particular which I was tensed about.
7.	The documentation prep – he gave all the guidance for the documents required, and also provided the templates for all the docs which were perfect because you just have to literally only change the placeholder values, even in excel.
8.	Day of the Interview – I was tensed and nervous, but his continuous support helped me to get the VISA.

All-in-all:
I highly recommend going with Binoy M. for the process and getting into your dream university with your best friend (I did with my best friend here at ASU). Believe it or not he will help and guide you in the best way possible. Don’t just take my word for it – you can even set an initial meeting with him and you’ll understand his process through and through by the man himself.
